{{Quote|Karagga the Beneficent places the highest priority on workplace safety!|[[Herald of Karagga]], upon a group of interlopers attacking the Kintan crusher Foreman Crusher|<ref name="SWTOR HH" />}}
The '''Kintan crushers''', also known as '''Kintan enforcers''' and a host of other names, were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of powerfully-built creatures from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. They were related to the [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan striders]], a species they surpassed in intelligence. Indeed, the Kintan crushers' obedience and ability to follow complex orders made them a favorite source for enforcers for members of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], and the species had been subject to [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of domestication by the Hutts by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Crushers were built to pound and bash: While their [[Limb/Legends|legs]] were short and stocky, their upper body and arms were immense and helped propel their meaty fists in combat. They became savage opponents in battle, slapping, stomping, and bashing foes and even causing minor [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. Crushers varied in size from slightly taller than an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]] to truly gargantuan proportions. While the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] often employed [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] to manage crushers in captivity, the species was capable of surviving in the wild by foraging.

Kintan crushers roamed the grounds of both the [[Fa'athra's Palace|palace]] of [[Voontara Fa'athra|Fa'athra]] the Hutt and [[Karagga's Palace|that]] of [[Karagga]] the Hutt on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Among these, [[Foreman Crusher]] was the most immense and formidable, guarding the entrance to Karagga's palace until being defeated by a group of invaders. Kintan crushers also lived beyond the borders of Hutt Space during the Cold War and its aftermath, with [[Gargath|one specimen]] roaming the [[Clabburn Tundra]] of the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Species/Legends|species]] related to the [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan striders]], Kintan crushers were more intelligent than their cousins. They were powerfully-built creatures who stood on two stocky [[Limb/Legends|legs]]<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> that emerged from prominent buttocks and terminated in two-toed feet.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" /> Kintan crushers sported heavily-muscled arms,<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> and the four clawed digits of their hands were capable of fine manipulation<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> and of closing into immense fists.<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> Members of the species had a hunched posture with the head jutting from the domed midsection at a right angle to the torso. Kintan crushers had no appreciable neck, and their facial features were minimal: two small [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a large, horizontal slit for a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]].<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> Two sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] jutted upward from the center of the lower jaw. A thick [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] lolled within the maw, ranging in [[Color/Legends|color]] from pale yellow<ref name="SWTOR HH" /> to pale gray.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" /> Crushers vocalized with a low, basso roar.<ref name="SWTOR HH" />

Kintan crusher hides came in a variety of brown<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> and gray shades. Some representatives of the species sported dark stripes that ran vertically along the back and the arms,<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" /> while others had uniformly-pigmented skin. The eyes featured a uniform pigmentation; various crushers sported eyes of brown,<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> yellow,<ref name="SWTOR HH" /> gray,<ref name="SWTOR Belsavis" /> and blue.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" />

Members of the species varied drastically in size. A smaller Kintan crusher stood slightly taller than an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> while larger specimens could grow so large that the same Human only came up to the crusher's knee. Also varying with overall size were rows of spikes that grew along the spine, the upper arms, and the lower legs. In immense crushers, these protruded prominently from the flesh,<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" /> while in smaller members of the species, the spikes were only barely visible. Crushers often lumbered about on their hind limbs,<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> but, when hurried, they used a quadrupedal ambulation, alternating their weight between their hands and feet as they ran forward.<ref name="SWTOR HH" /> The largest specimens were capable of causing minor [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] with their movements.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|This is it! No escape!|translated=1|Karagga, once a group of invaders gets past his Kintan crusher-patrolled moat|<ref name="SWTOR HH" />}}
[[File:Foreman_crusher_enchained.png|thumb|left|300px|Hutts regularly employed Kintan crushers during the Cold War and its aftermath. One such beast was Foreman Crusher, kept on Nal Hutta by Karagga the Hutt.]]
Although they were more intelligent than the semi-sentient Kintan striders, Kintan crushers were nevertheless ferocious and animalistic creatures. In their natural state, they lived in the wilds of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]],<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> where they foraged for [[Diet/Legends|food]], picking items up from the ground and eating them, whether solitary<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> or in small groups.<ref name="SWTOR Belsavis" /> However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], most crushers worked for various representatives of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Their relatively high intelligence enabled them to follow fairly involved commands, but it also made them smart enough to expect some sort of remuneration for doing their masters' bidding. Rumors abounded as to how the Hutts and their minions paid their crusher forces, with guesses ranging from the ridiculous to the shocking.<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> Crushers in the employ of the Hutts were sometimes accompanied by handlers; such crushers wore straps around the neck, upper arms, shoulders, wrist, and waist; their handlers could attach chains or ropes to these straps to subdue the crusher if need be.<ref name="SWTOR HH" />

The species was also known as "Kintan enforcers,"<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> and several other appellations referred to at least certain segments of the population. Some of these names included Kintan beast slaves, Kintan behemoths, Kintan maulers, Kintan rock throwers, Kintan warhounds,<ref name="SWTOR HH" /> Kintan ancients, and Kintan devourers.<ref name="SWTOR Belsavis" />

Crushers were fierce opponents in battle. Their primary attack was to pound an enemy with their fists,<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> but other tactics included slapping and stomping the foe, and either stamping<ref name="SWTOR HH" /> or pounding the ground to force an opponent to fly backward.<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> Kintan crushers also used their powerful upper body strength to lift large rocks and throw them overhead at an enemy. Another maneuver was to strike an enemy with the belly and feet to knock the foe backward.<ref name="SWTOR HH " /> Crushers of adequate size were capable of creating minor groundquakes to damage nearby foes. They defended themselves by protecting vital areas with their meaty upper limbs.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" /> At least some crushers had the tendency to fly into a battle frenzy after they had sustained enough injury; in such a state, the crusher moved faster and hit harder.<ref name="SWTOR HH" />

==History==
The Kintan crushers were named for the planet on which they evolved, Kintan,<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> which was a world that had been bathed in intense [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] when its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[M'dweshuu]], went [[Nova/Legends|nova]] in the world's ancient past. The radiation wiped out most life on the planet; that which survived [[mutate]]d into monstrous nightmares.<ref name="GATORW 86">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Among the surviving species were both the Kintan crushers and a cousin species, the Kintan striders. The planet was also home to the sentient [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]],<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> who established themselves as the dominant form of life there by nearly wiping out all other living creatures on the planet.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> Around [[25,100 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Kintan became a contested target in a [[Xim Wars|war]] between the forces of the Human [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who both wanted control of Kintan's region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]]. The Hutts convinced the Nikto to swear fealty to them,<ref name="GG12" /> and the Hutts and their servants bested Xim and his forces at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]].<ref name="HX5">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> Once Xim was defeated, the Hutts added the planet of Kintan to their empire, which eventually came to be known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EA" /> Several centuries before the Cold War, the Hutts learned to domesticate the Kintan crushers and use them in their criminal endeavors.<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" />

==Kintan crushers in the galaxy==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
===Nal Hutta===
{{Quote|My lord Karagga is concerned at his guests' failure to observe safety protocols.|Herald of Karagga, upon a group of interlopers reaching Karagga's stable of Kintan crushers and their handlers|<ref name="SWTOR HH" />}}
With more in Hutt employ than wild on their home planet by the Cold War, Kintan crushers lived throughout Hutt Space. The Hutts found them to be among their most loyal and reliable enforcers, and they often used them as muscle to fight their enemies.<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> For instance, [[Sludge Kintan]] was a crusher who roamed the grounds outside [[Voontara Fa'athra]]'s [[Fa'athra's Palace|palace]] in the [[Eastern Grime]] region of the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. An individual allied with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Sludge Kintan.<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> The [[Evocii]] rebel [[Grov (Evocii)|Grov]] the Destroyer enslaved a number of local wildlife that he set upon his enemies, including a Kintan crusher that had shock devices implanted in its spine and arms.<ref name="Bounty">{{TORcite|type=event|Bounty Contract Week}}</ref>

[[File:GargathsWatch-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|The massive Kintan crusher Gargath roamed the tundra of the ice planet Hoth during the Cold War.]]
By the time hostilities resumed between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire, [[Karagga]] the Hutt, leader of the Hutt Cartel, had several Kintan crushers on hand to protect the grounds of his [[Karagga's Palace|palace]] on Hutta. The crushers and their handlers roamed a yard near the runoff of the palace moat. The largest and fiercest crusher on Karagga's palace grounds was the immense [[Foreman Crusher]], who guarded the entrance to Karagga's [[Nal Hutta droid factory|droid factory]] just beyond the moat area. A group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|infiltrators]] handled the massive beast and kept him chained down unless needed. When a large group of hostile invaders penetrated the grounds of Karagga's palace, they overcame the Kintan crusher forces guarding the moat, prompting Karagga's handlers to release Foreman Crusher. The interlopers slew the beast in the ensuing battle, permitting them access to the depths of Karagga's greater palace.<ref name="SWTOR HH" />

===Beyond Hutt Space===
Later in the conflict, Kintan crushers helped guard [[Drilling Platform Fwanna]] on the [[Cartel mining mesa]] of the planet [[Makeb]]. The facility was under the control of [[Szajin]], the [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] of the Hutt Cartel during its invasion of the planet, and the crushers were under the supervision of [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] beast handlers.<ref name="ROTHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

Other crushers lived well beyond the bounds of Hutt Space. For instance, at the end of the Cold War, several crushers escaped captivity in the [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] of the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and took to roaming the [[Ancient Rakatan Keep]], the [[Caves of the Primeval Wardens]], and the [[Cells of the Lords of the Infinite]], all areas of [[the Tomb]],<ref name="SWTOR Belsavis" /> an ancient prison complex used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species and their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] to hold dangerous beings in stasis some 20,000 years before the Cold War.<ref name="SWTORE 333">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> During the same period, the enormous Kintan crusher known as [[Gargath]] patrolled a snowy region known as [[Gargath's Watch]], part of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. A group of offworlders confronted Gargath before the war's end, defeated the crusher in battle, and killed the beast.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Development and creation===
{{Quote|Foreman Crusher goes into a frenzy!|Battle narration during the fight with Foreman Crusher|<ref name="SWTOR HH" />}}
[[File:Kintan_crusher_art.png|thumb|right|180px|Zach Hall's "Kintan" creature design]]
The Kintan crushers were created as enemy characters for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], released by [[BioWare]] in [[December]] [[2011]].<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" /> Artist [[Zach Hall]] designed the species, which was labeled "Kintan" during development.<ref name="TAAMOSWTOR 127">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> The species name "Kintan crusher" is given in an entry for the game's built-in encyclopedia, the Codex, after the player defeats a "released Kintan ancient" enemy character on Belsavis.<ref name="SWTOR Belsavis" />

Several non-player characters in the game use the same general appearance and animations as the released Kintan ancient, although none explicitly names a species. Instead, most of these enemy characters use the label "Kintan" as if it were a species name rather than a planetary designation. These include Sludge Kintan on the planet Hutta;<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /> the Kintan devourers on Belsavis;<ref name="SWTOR Belsavis" /> and the Kintan behemoths, Kintan maulers, Kintan rock throwers, and Kintan warhounds found in the area of Karagga's palace in the multi-player operation "Hutt Hospitality." Finally, two of the characters are not identified by species at all: Foreman Crusher in the same operation&mdash;nicknamed "the Slavedriver"<ref name="SWTOR HH" />&mdash;and Gargath, a world boss on Hoth&mdash;called a "Snow Giant" in game text.<ref name="SWTOR Hoth" /> Both of these latter two characters grant a Codex entry upon being defeated, but neither explicitly names the species.<ref name="SWTOR Codex FC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Foreman Crusher}}</ref><ref name="SWTOR Codex G">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gargath}}</ref> The only difference among all of these characters is in overall size and the length of their spikes, so this article treats them as members of the same species, as detailed in the "Kintan Crusher" Codex entry granted upon defeat of a released Kintan ancient.<ref name="SWTOR Codex KC" />

===''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' game play===
In ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', the player may gain the Codex entry "Primeval Beasts" in the Tomb area of Belsavis, an area replete with "released Kintan devourer" and "released Kintan ancient" enemy types. The Codex mentions that many of the creatures held in the ancient prisons of Belsavis were deadlier than their counterparts on other worlds, possibly due to genetic tampering. Some of these creatures were kept in stasis since the days when the Rakata controlled the planet, others were allowed to breed for generations in sequestered colonies, while others were kept out of stasis yet alive, with no need for nourishment, from that same era. The entry does not specify into which of these categories the Kintan crushers on Belsavis fall, or whether they are more recent arrivals.<ref name="SWTOR Codex PB">{{TORcite|type=codex|Primeval Beasts}}</ref>

Completing the full storyline of ''The Old Republic'' only necessitates getting past&mdash;but not necessarily defeating&mdash;Karagga the Hutt's Kintan forces, except for Foreman Crusher, who must be killed. The operation is available to both the Sith Empire and Republic factions in the game, with little impact on the plot depending on the player characters' allegiance.<ref name="SWTOR HH" /> The other unique Kintan crushers in ''The Old Republic'' are completely optional encounters, but this article assumes all were defeated as part of full game completion.<ref name="SWTOR Hutta" /><ref name="SWTOR Hoth" />
